description: Who is buying and selling a token right now: every on-chain transfer in the last 1h / 6h / 24h split into DEX buys, sells and wallet transfers. Returns buy vs sell volume and net flow in USD, unique buyers and sellers, top net buyers and sellers, the largest trades (with tx hashes) and an organic-activity score with wash-trading signals (round-tripping, volume concentration, repeated bot-size trades). Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain. Paid ($0.01, x402).
name: token_flows
title: token flows
